common_conditions: XCAP referenced by TS24.481 V19.3.0; RFC4825 rules
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: Combine XCAP root and document selector; selector starts with AUID then users/XUI or global and document path. Root itself is not an operable resource.
Append /~~/ and restricted node selector; intermediate steps must each select one element. This is not full XPath or batch selection.

URI query xmlns() bindings resolve prefixes; unprefixed elements use application-usage default document namespace, unprefixed attributes have no namespace. Target document prefix declarations do not supply URI bindings.

limitations: Referenced RFC is not itself a Release19 standard.
MCX application schema, complete request headers and authorization are not established by these generic rules.
